Enter start and end date
Check 'Show Withdrawn' if desired
Click 'Refresh View' to update grid

workflows.name: View Application Details

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are flagged and their withdrawn date displayed.

CustomValidator to ensure start date is not after end date
conditions: Display warnings or errors as needed

summary: TimetableAssessments enables configuration and management of student assessments within a timetable, supporting multiple flows for add, edit, validation, and deletion.
purpose: To allow users to view, add, edit, and delete assessment records attached to a timetable, including validation and business rules.

fields.name: OpenDaysAfterStart
fields.description: Days after placement start that assessment opens

fields.name: CloseDaysAfterEnd
fields.description: Days after placement ends that assessment closes

fields.name: AssessorCanViewSubjectsAnswers
fields.description: If assessor can view subject answers

fields.name: SubjectsCanViewAssessorAnswers
fields.description: If subjects can view assessor answers

workflows.name: Assessment Management
steps: View existing assessments in grid.
Add new assessment via 'Add' button.
Edit an assessment via 'Edit' button.
Delete an assessment via 'Delete' button.
Handle validations for required fields and custom business logic.
Set open/close days, select templates, set permissions for assessors and subjects.

business_rules: Screen is editable only if user is not view-only and is admin/coordinator.
Instructor and supervisor assessments must not conflict.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator on open/close days, assessment template.
RegularExpressionValidator and CompareValidator for numeric fields.
CustomValidator (checkCloseDays) to ensure close days are valid.
calculations: Days after placement start/end for assessment periods.
conditions: If no data exists and screen is editable, show add button.
system_behavior: Assessment validation triggers error messages for missing or conflicting entries.
exceptions: InterimWithoutFinal validation prevents orphan interim assessments.
content_gaps: No explicit details on assessment scoring, export, or communication to students.

summary: StudentPrerequisites manages prerequisite, immunization, safety, and confidentiality records for students, including comprehensive validations and update workflows.
purpose: To track and validate student prerequisite requirements, update immunization and safety records, and enforce complex business rules on data entry.

workflows.name: Update Student Prerequisite
steps: Validate prerequisite record via IsValid routine.
Populate fields and call appropriate update stored procedure.
Update includes immunization, mask fit, safety, and confidentiality details.

workflows.name: Validate Student Prerequisite Record
steps: Verify all date ranges (e.g., not too far in future/past).
Enforce special business rules for each immunization, mask, and consent field.

business_rules: Dates for tests and immunizations must not be more than 5 years in the past.
Year values for confirmed years must be within allowed ranges.
Mask fit tests require completion if mask size specified.
Expiry date must be after fit test date if expiry years specified.
Medical and confidentiality forms are required for prerequisites.
Errors are accumulated during validation and presented to user.
Immunization requirements must be met as per agency, location, and program specifications.
validations: Date validation for all immunizations, mask fit, and safety fields.
Year validation for confirmed disease years.
Check for non-empty values where required.
calculations: Date formatting for display fields (e.g., AdminDateFormatted, ExpiryDateDplFormatted).
Expiry checks and coloring for approaching expiry.
conditions: Null or zero IDs trigger no database query.
Alt language fields are used for localization.
system_behavior: Provides formatted and color-coded display for key fields.
exceptions: Errors are accumulated and returned if validation fails.
content_gaps: Field documentation is extremely detailed; specific workflow and actor business rules are complex and require further mapping for full automation.
